CONTROLS

📱 Touch

Left stickSteer · push/brake (up/down) · spin in air · trick direction
A (bottom)Crouch = speed up · release to ollie (hold longer = higher)
X (left)Flip trick — hold a stick direction and tap
B (right)Grab trick (hold) — hold a stick direction too
Y (top)Grind — tap near a rail / ledge / coping
Stick left/rightWhile grinding: balance — press away from the tip
Stick down then upManual (up/down flick for Nose Manual), then balance the pitch
STARTStart / restart the run
?Toggle this panel

🎮 Gamepad (Xbox / XInput)

Left stickSteer (analog) · Spin in air · Trick direction
A (hold)Crouch = speed up · release to ollie (hold longer = higher)
X + directionFlip trick — can be pressed during the crouch, fires on takeoff
B + directionGrab trick (hold)
Y + directionGrind — tap in the air near a rail / ledge / coping and it pulls you in
Left stick ← →While grinding: balance. Press away from the way you are tipping — a light touch, the board takes a moment to follow
Left stick ↓↑ flickManual (down then up). Flick ↑↓ for a Nose Manual
Left stick ↑ ↓While manualling: balance the pitch. Ollie to leave it, and the combo carries on
Left stick ↓ / LTBrake / slow down
Left stick ↑ / RTExtra push (the skater pushes by himself when slow)
LB / RBSpin left / right in air
Right stickNudge camera
StartStart / restart run
BackToggle this panel

← → / A DSteer · Spin · Trick direction
Space (hold)Crouch = speed up · release to ollie
JFlip trick (works during the crouch too)
KGrab trick (hold)
LGrind (tap in the air near a rail)
← → / A DWhile grinding: balance — press away from the tip
↓↑ flickManual (↑↓ for Nose Manual); then ↑ / ↓ balance the pitch
↓ / SBrake
↑ / WExtra push
Q / ESpin left / right in air
